title: Cart page
evidence: 30 stores add a recently viewed shelf

steps.note: Bestsellers or new arrivals: what a first visitor's empty cart shows. A curated collection copied whole from a pulled shelf.
Last: the visitor's history, empty on a first visit. Needs no catalog ids.

notes: The empty cart of a new visitor shows only the cart heading and a button: the bestsellers shelf is what keeps the page from being a dead end (`page-dead-end`).
